about.label: About
about.text: A UX/UI designer with 6+ years designing mobile apps, web apps, systems and AI-powered products.I've helped products across more than one country grow through clear experiences that serve users and business goals — from research and idea to the last detail in the interface.

steps.d: Stakeholder talks, user interviews, audits and competitive analysis. Understanding the real problem before drawing a single box.
Information architecture, user flows and wireframes that turn insight into structure — tested early, changed cheaply.
High-fidelity interfaces, interaction details and a design system that keeps every screen consistent as the product grows.
Developer-ready handoff, QA with engineers and post-launch iteration driven by real usage data.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.desc: Words from people I've worked with, on the process and the outcome.

items.a: I combine UX with visual identity, and stay with the project from research to developer-ready handoff, so nothing gets lost between design and build.
Mobile apps, web apps, design systems and visual identity — from research to the last detail.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Depends on scope, but I set a clear timeline up front and stick to it.

items.q: What language do we talk in?
items.a: Arabic or English — whichever suits you.
